footnotes: p. 79 n. 1 (mark on 'sen', end of § F, p. 79 row 5): Var. em t'at'at àmt mitu ḳerḥ pui en àrit sàpt menta - set, "before the divine beings among the dead [on] night that of making judgment annihilated are they." See Naville, Todtenbuch, Bd. II., Bl. 79.
p. 79 n. 2 (mark on 'àmt', § G line 1, p. 79 row 6): Var. àm uat mita, "in the way of the dead."
p. 81 n. 1 (mark on 'āut', p. 81 row 1): Var. àbu.
p. 81 n. 2 (mark on 'àru', § I line 2, p. 81 row 8): Var. āā àru, "Mighty one of forms."
p. 81 n. 3 (mark on 'χepeś', p. 81 row 8): The papyrus of Nebseni adds t'at'a, "head."
notes: Section boundaries match the brief: F = p.79 row 1 'àr' to 'sen' (row 5); G = p.79 row 6 to 'χefta - f' p.80 row 7; H = p.80 row 7 to 'àru' p.81 row 6 (Budge's transliteration is 'àru', the brief's 'seśeta āru' = 'seśeta àru'); I = p.81 row 6 to 'χefta - f' p.82 row 5; J = p.82 row 5 to 'ḥeḥ sep' p.83 last row. Line numerals: F 1–4 (2. inside smaāχeru, 4. inside pui); G 1–4 (2. inside Àsṭennu); H 1–4 (2. inside χeperu - sen, 3. inside ertāu - entu); I 1–4 (2. inside seśeta); J 1–6 (3. inside semaāχeru p.82 row 8; 4. before āāt, 5. before ṭer - f, 6. before ṭāṭā on p.83) — split words keep the earlier line. Overlines: p.79 row 1 àr…Abṭu; p.79 row 2 over à only; p.79 row 6 àr…mitu; p.80 row 1 àr sàpt continuing p.80 row 2 over menti - sen; p.80 row 3 à; p.80 row 7 àr (§ H) continuing over all of row 8 (t'at'at … Ṭeṭṭeṭu, i.e. including χebs - ta em Ṭeṭṭeṭu); p.81 row 3 à; p.81 row 6 àr (§ I) … Naàrereṭef to row end; p.81 row 7 àr ḳerḥ pui en continuing p.81 row 8 over seśeta and àru; p.82 row 1 à (rule printed slightly broken/dotted); p.82 row 5 àr t'at'at (§ J) continuing p.82 row 6 over āāt àmt Re - stau; p.82 row 8 à; p.83 from t'eṭṭu (row 3) every word to the end (rows 4–8 fully overlined). No square brackets in the hieroglyph lines and no (sic)/(?) anywhere in the range; brackets occur only in the English ([who], [on], [the festival of], [when], [of], [with], [one], [and he maketh], [which]). Running head on p.83 reads 'B.D. CHAP. XXIII.' (not XVIII) — printed so. Recurring shape questions: the low hooked sign U15 is printed as det after several signs (χenà - tu, χebs - ta, samiu, sefet, t'erà - entu, qeres, ṭer - f, seśeṭṭu) where no ā stands in Budge; the low flat ā in āāt/āḥā/ā and the sign under D21 in ertāu are the same printed shape (coded D36, but D37 in ertāu per ruling); t'at'at is printed in two arrangements (U28 U28 + ring/X1 over N1, or U28 ring/X1 U28 N1) — signs always given in house order with q describing the print; the enemy/dead det is one kneeling figure with an arm raised to the head (A13 approx throughout); Ani's det A52 except p.81 row 4 (A1). Teḥuti varies: G26 X1 Z4, a compressed G26 group, or G26 alone (p.81 row 3).
